generated_from: idp_public_recovery.sqlite + sanitized CSVs + WordPress.com WXR recovery + public WordPress recovery overlay

recovery_overlay.permanent_source: WordPress.com WXR export captured 2026-09-23 and offline enriched archive
recovery_overlay.live_source: WordPress.com public REST API, used only to hydrate published WordPress text/version records at runtime
recovery_overlay.live_base_archive: The committed static forum/poetry recovery remains the preservation base; the public API is not the sole archival copy.
recovery_overlay.privacy: No private messages, email addresses, IP addresses, credentials, or password material are added by the recovery overlay.

interface_reconstruction.basis: Surviving phpbb_config/phpbb_themes records and public style-discussion posts
interface_reconstruction.exact_graphics_status: Core subSilver gradient/folder/minipost assets restored from a public phpBB2 source mirror; Helius and skyLineGrey binary assets remain pending exact-pack ingestion.
interface_reconstruction.text_repair_scope: Display-time substitution of common mojibake only; source data unchanged.
interface_reconstruction.subsilver_asset_restoration: category/header gradients; forum/topic folder icons; mini-post marker; mini navigation icons; latest-reply arrow; phpBB2-style forum index statistics and historical icon key
interface_reconstruction.layout_template_source: public phpBB2 subSilver index_body.tpl, viewforum_body.tpl, viewtopic_body.tpl, overall_header.tpl, overall_footer.tpl mirror
interface_reconstruction.layout_restoration: forum Last Post; forum-topic Author/Last Post; Author/Message thread header; previous/next topic navigation; phpBB-style breadcrumbs
interface_reconstruction.subsilver_nav_icon_scope: Forum Index, Search, Memberlist, FAQ/About only; shown only in subSilver
interface_reconstruction.last_post_link_behavior: Recovered icon_latest_reply.gif links to the final surviving 20-post page for each topic
interface_reconstruction.topic_author_visibility: Forum topic lists show each thread starter both in the traditional Author column and inline beneath the topic title; inline attribution remains visible on narrow/mobile layouts. Topic search results and topic headers also identify the starter where recoverable.

creative_archive.provenance_policy: Authorship/provenance, completion status, and publication permission are separate axes. No automatic attribution or publication without supporting evidence/approval.

continuity_corpus.caveat: Source blocks are reconciliation units, not final works or Seed counts.
continuity_corpus.public_layer_policy: Private notebooks contribute chronology and aggregate continuity evidence without automatic publication.

media_reconciliation.sync_mode: daily scheduled public-channel scan (Videos + Shorts + available Live)

release_note: v3.23 preserves the visitor-first v3.22 experience while clarifying that the visible Seed exhibit is a conservative, publish-safe layer over a much larger private continuity corpus. Recovered private creative-source chronology now reaches at least 2012, and provenance reconciliation is synchronized without publishing private notebook text.

visitor_analytics.blocker: cloudflareAnalyticsToken is still blank in museum-static/museum-config.js
visitor_analytics.note: No detailed museum visitor telemetry is being collected until a site token is configured.
